cards.title: Foundation: solution, SQLite + migrations, settings file, logging, tray, Windows CI
Clients, tasks and lists management UI, incl. Phase 2 refinements
Check-in popup: record, reuse previous task, create task, notes, details
Tracking engine: segments, pause/resume, sleep/lock/clock handling, Today timeline
Check-in interval presets and custom value
cards.description: Presets 1/5/10/15/30/60 minutes plus custom; applied immediately, no duplicate or backlog prompts.
acceptance: changing the interval moves the next check-in in Overview and the popups follow it.
cards.evidence: engine interval tests, `SettingsTests`. Could not be verified while WT-010 blocked check-ins.

cards.title: Global shortcut opens a focused check-in from any app
Scheduled check-ins appear reliably
cards.description: Scheduled check-ins did not appear on the owner's machine (Unobtrusive, Focused, auto-dismiss, "show now"). Likely cause: a wake reported only as an automatic resume left tracking "asleep"; also guards a lock without unlock.
acceptance: With a 1-minute interval, check-ins appear in Unobtrusive mode (no focus taken) and in Focused mode (takes focus).
They appear while the main window is closed to the tray, and after sleep/wake (within about a minute).
An ignored check-in closes after its countdown and shows as "missed" in Overview.
cards.evidence: `RealAppTests` (real WorkTrace.exe in CI), `SchedulingTests`, engine tests. Not yet confirmed on the owner's machine.

cards.title: Tracking status and last check-in visible
cards.description: Overview and Settings show Active / Paused / check-ins off / error, interval, next check-in, the last attempt with its outcome, and a warning when check-ins are held back or failing.
acceptance: the status matches what happens (pause, resume, missed, answered); nothing fails without a visible reason.

cards.title: "Show a scheduled check-in now" explains itself
cards.description: Uses the real scheduled path; when it cannot show one it says why (paused, popup already open, session locked).
acceptance: shows a popup with countdown when tracking; shows a clear message when paused or a popup is open.

cards.title: Popup countdown
cards.description: Compact mm:ss countdown on scheduled popups; paused while the pointer is over the popup; stops on interaction; closes and records a missed check-in on expiry. No focus stealing, tick stops when not needed.
acceptance: behaves as described in both popup modes.

cards.title: Alt+1–4 records a recent task
cards.description: Handled at window level (top row and number pad); never types into the search box; does nothing without recents.
acceptance: with the popup active and search empty, Alt+1 records recent task 1 and closes the popup, no characters typed.

cards.title: Custom interval validation (R08)
cards.description: Whole minutes 1–240 only.
acceptance: 0, 241, 1.5 rejected with a message; 7 accepted and applied.

cards.title: Pause and resume in tray and Overview (R09)
acceptance: timed and indefinite pause show in tray menu and Overview; Resume appears only while paused; a timed pause resumes by itself.
cards.evidence: `TrackingStateTests`. Tray menu appearance is a manual check.

cards.title: Close to tray, reopen, single instance (R10)
acceptance: closing the window keeps WorkTrace running in the tray; starting it again opens the existing window.

cards.title: WorkTrace logo in the popup header
cards.description: Small vector logo.
acceptance: looks right in light and dark themes.

cards.title: Estimation engine
cards.description: Phase 4. Reconstruct time from segments, lock periods, observations, prompts and manual allocations. Blocked by WT-010 (scheduled check-ins must work on the owner's machine first).
acceptance: the nine time-estimation invariants in CLAUDE.md hold, each covered by tests; estimates are labelled Estimated, never Confirmed; recalculation never discards manual allocations.

cards.title: Activity log
cards.description: Phase 4. Editable day view of observations and estimated periods: filters, auto-save, undo (ChangeLog), manual allocations, split and merge.
acceptance: owner can correct a day's time without losing original observations; undo restores the previous state.

cards.title: Screenshots
cards.description: Phase 5. Opt-in primary-monitor capture, PNG default or JPEG with quality, date folders, viewer, retention and deletion, no capture while locked, notification excluded from the capture.

cards.title: Weekly timesheets
cards.description: Phase 6. Week view, grouping and totals, unclassified time, adjustments with reconciliation, rounding, CSV (Danish-friendly, injection-safe) and JSON export.

cards.title: Polish and release
cards.description: Phase 7. Start with Windows, theme, hand-tuned tray icons, backup/restore UI, packaging, user documentation.

cards.title: Tray notification when check-ins are held back
cards.description: Today the warning is shown only in the main window. A tray balloon could tell the owner sooner.

cards.title: Automated check of the tray menu's appearance
cards.description: Tray menu layout is verified manually today.

cards.title: Interactive Kanban board with GitHub sync
cards.description: Browser board (GitHub Pages) backed by docs/board.json on the board branch, with version-checked saves, conflict handling, undo, archive and a CLI for Claude Code.
acceptance: Drag a card to another column; the status persists after refreshing and Claude Code sees it
Edit notes and add timestamped comments; they persist after refresh
Archive a Done card, find it in the Archive and restore it
Undo works for moves and edits
Conflicting edits never silently overwrite each other; save failures are clearly visible
Works in desktop and phone layouts
No token or secret in committed code or public files
cards.evidence: Unit, sync and CLI tests (47) and browser tests (19, 3 runs) green; real GitHub tests on branch board-synctest (concurrent edits, same-field conflict, concurrent comments, stale save refused, retry no-op, browser sees CLI changes).

cards.title: Inbox and quick capture
cards.description: Capture a thought in seconds: title only, Enter saves into a separate Inbox (not a sixth Kanban column). Optional notes, links and screenshots. Inbox counter; move items onto the board when ready.
acceptance: Typing a title and pressing Enter captures it into the Inbox
The Inbox shows a counter and lists captured items, newest first
An Inbox item can be moved to a board column or archived
No category or other field is required
Existing cards and the five columns are unchanged

cards.title: Screenshots on cards (paste, drop, browse)
cards.description: Ctrl+V, drag-and-drop and file picker in Quick Capture and on cards. Several images per card, thumbnails, enlarge, optional caption, remove. Until a storage decision is made, images stay in this browser only and are never uploaded to the public repository.
acceptance: Ctrl+V, drag-and-drop and Browse each attach an image
Thumbnails, enlarge, caption and remove work
Nothing is uploaded to GitHub; the card says the images are on this device only
Large base64 images are never written to board.json

cards.title: Links: multiple per card, quick copy and open
cards.description: Several external links per card, each with Open and Copy. Paste a URL; the label is optional. Bare URLs in notes become links.
acceptance: Add a link by pasting just the URL
Each link can be opened or copied with one click

cards.title: Backup & Export: ZIP download and restore
cards.description: Manual backup without any service: download a ZIP of the complete board, one creation month or selected cards (with this device's screenshots). Restore from such a ZIP with validation and a preview; nothing is overwritten without confirmation, comments are merged, never lost.
acceptance: Download complete / month / selected cards as ZIP
Each monthly ZIP restores on its own
Restore validates the file and previews new, changed and unchanged cards before applying
Restoring never deletes cards or comments

cards.title: Decide: screenshot storage and email delivery
cards.description: Owner decision needed. See docs/proposals/2026-10-29-screenshots-and-email-backup.md on the board branch: where screenshots are stored privately (recommended: a private GitHub repository), and which service sends backup email (recommended: a transactional email API with its key in a GitHub Actions secret).
acceptance: Storage location for screenshots chosen
Email sending service and credential handling chosen
Recurring cost confirmed (expected: none)

cards.title: Screenshot storage that syncs between devices
cards.description: Store screenshots privately (not in the public repository) so they appear on every device and can be backed up. Depends on the storage decision.
acceptance: Screenshots added on one device appear on another
No screenshot is publicly readable
Images that existed only on this device can be uploaded once storage exists

cards.title: Automatic daily email backup to Outlook
cards.description: Daily check; send only when board data or screenshots changed since the last successful backup. One archive per creation month with the complete latest state of its tasks (incl. archived tasks, notes, comments, links, history, all screenshots); changed months are resent. Backup & Export gains Send now, recipient, test email, last success, pending changes, failures and retry. Predictable subjects for Outlook rules; oversized archives are split, never trimmed.
acceptance: Only changed months are sent, each independently restorable
A backup counts as successful only when the sending service accepted it
Oversized archives are split into numbered parts; nothing is omitted
Recipient, test email, send now, last success and retry are available
